€10U. (गुणयति-ते, गुणित) 
__1 To multiply. 
__2 To advise. 
__3 To invite.
a. Of good quality (गुणवान्); भ्राता कथं नाम मया गुणस्य भ्रातुर्वधं राम विरोचयेत [[

[गुण्-अच्] 
__1 A quality (good or bad); सुगुण, दुर्गुण; यदङ्गनारूपसरूपतायाः कञ्चिद्गुणं भेदकमिच्छतीभिः [[Śi. 3. 42.]] 
__2 
___(a) A good quality, merit, virtue, excellence; कतमे ते गुणाः [[
]]; वसन्ति हि प्रेम्णि गुणा न वस्तुनि [[

.]] 
___(b) Eminence. 
__3 Use, advantage, good (with instr. usually), [[

.]] 
__4 Effect, result, efficacy, good result; संभावनागुणमवेहि तमीश्वराणाम् [[Ś. 7. 4]]; गुणमहतां महते गुणाय योगः [[

]]; 6. 7. 
__5 
___(a) A single thread or string. 
___(b) Thread, string, rope, cord, मेखलागुणैः [[

]] (where गुण also means ‘a merit’). 
__6 The bow-string; गुणकृत्ये धनुषो नियोजिता [[

.]] 
__7 The string of a musical instrument; कलवल्लकीगुणस्वानमानम् [[Śi. 4. 57.]] 
__8 A sinew. 
__9 A quality, attribute, property in general; यादृग्गुणेन भर्त्रा स्त्री संयुज्येत यथाविधि [[

.]] 
__10 A quality, characteristic or property of all substances, one of the seven categories of padārthas of the Vaiśeṣikas, (the number of these properties is 24). 
__11 An ingredient or constituent of nature, any one of the three properties belonging to all created things; (these are सत्त्व, रजस् and तमस्); गुणत्रयविभागाय [[

.]] 
__12 A wick, cotton thread; नृपदीपो धनस्नेहं प्रजाभ्यः संहरन्नपि । अन्तरस्थैर्गुणैः शुभ्रैर्लक्ष्यते नैव केनचित् ॥ [[

.]] 
__13 An object of sense, (these are five रूप, रस, गन्ध, स्पर्श, and शब्द); गुणैर्गुणान्स भुञ्जान आत्मप्रद्योतितैः प्रभुः [[

.]] 
__14 Repetition, multiplication, denoting ‘folds’ or ‘times’, usually at the end of comp. after numerals; आहारो द्विगुणः स्त्रीणां बुद्धिस्तासां चतुर्गुणा । षड्गुणो व्यवसायश्च कामश्चाष्टगुणः स्मृतः ॥ [[
]]; so त्रिगुण; शतगुणीभवति becomes a hundred-fold, अध्यर्धगुणमाहुर्यं बले शौर्ये च केशव [[

.]] 
__15 A secondary element, a subordinate part (opp. मुख्य); न च गुणानुग्रहार्थं प्रधानस्यावृत्तिर्युक्ता [[ŚB. on

.]] 
__16 Excess, abundance, superfluity; पराङ्मुखवधं कृत्वा कोऽत्र प्राप्तस्त्वया गुणः [[

.]] 
__17 An adjective, a word subordinate to another in a sentence. 
__18 The substitution of ए, ओ, अर् and अल् for इ, उ, ऋ (short or long) and ऌ, or the vowels अ, ए, ओ and अर् and अल्. 
__19 (In Rhet.) Quality considered as an inherent property of a Rasa or sentiment. Mammaṭa thus defines गुण.--ये रहस्याङ्गिनो धर्माः शौर्यादय इवात्मनः । उत्कर्षहेतवस्ते स्युरचलस्थितयो गुणाः ॥ [[K.

.]] (Some writers on rhetoric, such as Vāmana, Jagannātha Paṇḍita, Daṇḍin and others, consider Guṇas to be properties both of शब्द and अर्थ, and mention ten varieties under each head. Mammaṭa, however, recognises only three, and, after discussing and criticizing the views of others, says: माधुर्यैजःप्रसादाख्यास्त्रयस्ते न पुनर्दश [[K.

.]] [Page0662-1] 
__20 (In gram. and [[Mīm.]]) Property considered as the meaning of a class of words; e. g. grammarians recognise four kinds of the meaning of words; जाति, गुण, क्रिया and द्रव्य, and give गौः, शुक्लः, चलः and डित्थः as instances to illustrate these meanings. 
__21 (In politics) A proper course of action, an expedient. (The expedients to be used by a king in foreign politics are six:-- 1 सन्धि peace or alliance; 2 विग्रह war; 3 यान march or expedition; 4 स्थान or आसन halt; 5 संश्रय seeking shelter; 6 द्वैध or द्वैधीभाव duplicity; सन्धिर्ना विग्रहो यानमासनं द्वैधमाश्रयः [[Ak.]]) see [[

.]] 
__22 The number ‘three’ (derived from the three qualities). 
__23 The chord of an are (in geom.). 
__24 An organ of sense. 
__25 A subordinate dish; [[

]], 233. 
__26 A cook. 
__27 An epithet of Bhīma as in युधिष्ठिरोऽपि गुणप्रियः [[Vās.]] 
__28 Leaving, abandonment. 
__29 A multiplier, coefficient (in math.) 
__30 Division, subdivision, species, kind. 
__31 The peculiar property of letters which are pronounced with external utterance (बाह्यप्रयत्न); they are eleven. 
-Comp. 
-अग्र्यम् a principal quality; °वर्तिन्; स्वमूर्तिभेदेन गुणाग्र्यवर्तिना पतिः प्रजानामिव सर्गमात्मनः [[

]]; 9. 331; अनपेक्ष्य गुणागुणौ जनः स्वरुचिं निश्चयतोऽनुधावति [[Śi.]] 16. 44. 
-अतीत a. freed from all properties, being beyond them; सर्वारम्भपरित्यागी गुणातीतः स उच्यते [[

.]] (-तः) the Supreme Being. 
-अधिष्ठानकम् the region of the breast where the girdle is fastened. 
-अनुबन्धित्वम् connection or association with virtues; गुणा गुणानुबन्धित्वात्तस्य सप्रसवा इव [[

.]] 
-अनुरागः love or appreciation of the good qualities of others; गुणानुरागादिव सख्यमीयिवान्न बाधतेऽस्य त्रिगणः परस्परम् [[

.]] 
-अनुरोधः conformity or suitableness to good qualities. 
-अन्तरम् a different (higher) quality; गुणान्तरं व्रजति शिल्पमाधातुः [[

.]] 
-अन्वित, -उपपन्न, -युक्त, -संपन्न a. endowed with good qualities, meritorious, worthy, good, excellent. 
-अपवादः, -निन्दा disparagement, detraction. 
-अभिधानम् A subsidiary injunction; द्रव्योपदेशाद्वा गुणाभिधानं स्यात् [[

.]] 
-आकरः 
__1 ‘a mine of merits’, one endowed with all virtues; सृजति तावदशेषगुणाकरं पुरुषरत्नमलङ्करणं भुवः [[

.]] 
__2 N. of Śiva. 
-आढ्य a. rich in virtues. 
-आत्मन् a. having qualities. 
-आधारः ‘a receptacle of virtues’, a virtuous or meritorious person. 
-आश्रय a. virtuous, excellent. 
-ईश्वरः 
__1 the Supreme Being. 
__2 the Chitrakūṭa mountain. 
-उत्कर्षः excellence of merit, possession of superior qualities. 
-उत्कीर्तनम् panegyric, eulogium. 
-उत्कृष्ट a. superior in merit; [[

.]] 
-उपेत a. endowed with good qualities; पुत्रमेवङ्गुणोपेतं चक्रवर्तिनमाप्नुहि [[Ś. 1. 12.]] 
-ओघः, -घम् superior or abundant merits. 
-कथनम् extolling, praising. 
__2 a condition or state of mind of the hero of a drama to which he is reduced by Cupid. 
-कर्तृत्वम् the state of an agent of properties; गुणकर्तृत्वेऽपि तथा कर्तेव भवत्युदासीनः [[Sāṅ.

.]] 
-कर्मन् n. 
__1 an unessential or secondary action. 
__2 (in gram.) the secondary or less immediate [Page0662-2] (i. e. indirect) object of an action; e. g. in the example नेताऽश्वस्य स्रुघ्नं स्रुघ्नस्य वा, स्रुघ्नम् is a गुणकर्मन. 
-°विभाग a. distinguishing an action and an attribute. 
-कल्पना f. imputing a figurative meaning, one of the modes of interpreting a sentence. According to it an expression may be understood as conveying not what is actually expressed by it but the quality or qualities thereof. e. g. सिंहो देवदत्तः means प्रसह्यकरी देवदत्तः; [[ŚB. on

.]] 
-काण्डः a series of subsidiary (details); एवमेक उत्कृष्यमाणः सर्वं गुणकाण्डमुत्कर्षति [[ŚB. on

.]] 
-कार a. productive of good qualities, profitable, salutary. 
(-रः) 
__1 a cook who prepares side-dishes or any secondary articles of food. 
__2 an epithet of Bhīma. 
__3 (in math.) the multiplier. 
-कीर्तनम्, -श्लाघा, -स्तुतिः f. praise, extolling. 
-कृत्यम् the function of a bow-string; गुणकृत्ये धनुषो नियोजिता [[

.]] 
-गणः a number or series of good qualities; [[

.]] 
-गानम् singing of merits, panegyric, praise. 
-गृध्नु a. 
__1 desiring good qualities; ये चान्ये गुणगृध्नवः [[

.]] 
__2 possessing enviable or good qualities. 
-गृह्य a. appreciating or admiring merits (wherever they may be), attached to merits; appreciative; ननु वक्तृविशेषनिःस्पृहा गुणगृह्या वचने विपश्चितः [[

.]] 
-गौरी a woman chaste by virtuous conduct; अनृतगिरं गुणगौरि मा कृथा माम् [[Śi.]] 
-ग्रहणम् appreciating merits. 
-ग्रहीतृ, -ग्राहक, -ग्राहिन् a. appreciating the merits (of others); श्रीहर्षो निपुणः कविः परिषदप्येषा गुणग्राहिणी [[

.]] 
-ग्रामः a collection of virtues or merits; गुरुतरगुणग्रामांभोजस्फुटोज्ज्वलचन्द्रिका [[

.]] 
-घातिन् a. detractor, envious, censorious. 
-ज्ञ a. knowing how to admire or appreciate merits, appreciative; भगवति कमलालये भृशमगुणज्ञासि [[

.]] 
-त्रयम्, -त्रितयम् the three constituent properties of nature; i. e. सत्त्व, रजस् and तमस्. °आभासः life. 
-दोषौ (du.) virtue and vice; °कथा; [[

.]] 
-धर्मः the virtue or duty incidental to the possession of certain qualities. 
-निधिः a store of virtues. 
-पदी a woman having feet as thin as cords. 
-पूगम् great merits; भवद्गुणपूगपूरितम् (श्रवणम्) [[Śi. 9. 64.]] 
-प्रकर्षः excellence of merits, great merit; गुणप्रकर्षादुडुपेन शम्भोरलङ्ध्यमुल्लङ्घितमुत्तमाङ्गम् [[

.]] 
-भावः being subsidiary to something else; परार्थता हि गुणभावः । [[ŚB. on

.]] 
-भोक्तृ a. perceiving the properties of things; निर्गुणं गुणभोक्तृ च [[

.]] 
-महत् a superior quality. 
-मुष्टिः f. a particular method of stringing the bow; cf. पताका वज्रमुष्टिश्च सिंहकर्णस्तथैव च । मत्सरी काकतुण्डी च योजनीया यथाक्रमम् ॥ [[

.]] 
-रागः delighting in the merits of others; गुणरागगतां तस्य रूपिणीमिव दुर्गतिम् [[

.]] 
-राशिः an epithet of Śiva 
-लक्षणम् mark or indication of an internal property. 
-लयनिका, -लयनी a tent. 
-लुब्ध a. 
__1 desirous of merits. 
__2 attached to merits. 
-वचनम्, -वाचकः a word which connotes an attribute or quality, an adjective, or substantive used attributively; [Page0663-1] as श्वते in श्वेतोऽश्वः. 
-वादः 
__1 pointing out good merits. 
__2 a statement in a secondary sense; गुणवादस्तु [[

]] (Śabara explains this as: गौण एष वादो भवति यत् सम्बन्धिनि स्तोतव्ये सम्बन्ध्यन्तरं स्तूयते । [[ŚB. on MS.]] on ibid.). 
__3 a statement contradictory to other arguments; [[Madhusūdana.]] 
-विवेचना discrimination in appreciating the merits of others, a just sense of merit. 
-विशेषाः external organs, mind and spiritual ignorance; परस्परविलक्षणा गुणविशेषाः (बाह्येन्द्रियमनोऽहङ्काराश्च) [[Sāṅ.

.]] 
-षः a different property. 
-वृक्षः, -वृक्षकः a mast or a post to which a ship or boat is fastened. 
-वृत्तिः f. 
__1 a secondary or unessential condition or relation (opp. मुख्यवृत्ति). 
__2 the character or style of merits. 
-वैशेष्यम् pre-eminence of merit; अन्योन्यगुणवैशेष्यान्न किंचिदतिरिच्यते [[

.]] 
-शब्दः an adjective. 
-संख्यानम् ‘enumeration of the three essential qualities’, a term applied to the Sāṅkhya (including the Yoga) system of philosophy; ज्ञानं कर्म च कर्ता च त्रिधैव गुणभेदतः प्रोच्यते गुणसंख्याने [[

.]] 
-संगः 
__1 association with qualities or merits. 
__2 attachment to objects of sense or worldly pleasures. 
-संग्रहः a collection of merits or properties; कथं गुणज्ञो विरमेद्विना पशुं श्रीर्यत्प्रवव्रे गुणसंग्रहेच्छया [[

.]] 
-संपद् f. excellence or richness of merits, great merit, perfection; गुणसंपदा समधिगम्य [[

.]] 
-सागरः 
__1 ‘an ocean of merit, a very meritorious man. 
__2 an epithet of Brahmā. 
-हीन a. 
__1 void of merit’, meritless; काममामरणात्तिष्ठेद्गृहे कन्यर्तुमत्यपि । न चैवैनां प्रयच्छेत्तु गुणहीनाय कर्हिचित् [[

ind. 
__1 According to the three chief qualities (of all existing things); [[

.]] 
__2 According to property. 
__3 According to merit.

गुणता,
 
-त्वम् 
__1 Subordination, dependence. 
__2 Virtue, excellence, good qualities. 
__3 Being endowed with or possession of, qualities in general. 
__4 Multiplication. 
__5 The state of a rope or cord.

[गुण्-ल्युट्] 
__1 Multiplication. 
__2 Enumeration. 
__3 Describing merits or qualities, pointing out or enumerating merits; इह रसभणने कृतहरिगुणने मधुरिपुपदसेवके [[

.]] 
__4 Reiterated study, repetition. 
-नी Examining books, studying; collating and correcting copies to determine the value of variants.

[गुण् भावे युच् स्वार्थे क] 
__1 Study, repeated reading, repetition; विशेषविदुषः शास्त्रं यत्तवोद्ग्राह्यते पुरः । हेतुः परिचयस्थैर्ये वक्तुर्गुणनिकैव सा ॥ [[Śi. 2. 75]] (आम्रेडितम् [[Malli.]]); श्रुतेर्गुणनिकानिकामपरिपूतवक्त्राम्बुजान् [[Viś.

.]] 
__2 Dancing, the science or profession of dancing. 
__3 The prologue or introduction to a drama. 
__4 A garland, necklace; दरिद्राणां चिन्तामणिगुणनिका [[Ā.

.]] 
__5 Determining the value of the various readings of a manuscript. 
__6 A cipher, the character in arithmetic which expresses nothing.

a. [गुण् करणे अनीयर्] 
__1 To be multiplied. 
__2 To be enumerated. 
__3 To be advised. 
-यः Study, practice. 
-यम् The multiplicand.

a. 
__1 Consisting of single threads. 
__2 Consisting of the three constituent properties of nature. 
__3 Possessed of merits, meritorious.

a. 
__1 Endowed with good qualities, virtuous, meritorious, good, excellent; गुणवति भृत्ये (निवेद्य दुःखं सुखी भवति) [[

.]] 
__2 Endowed with qualities. 
__3 Delicious; भोजयेत्तान्गुणवता सदन्नेन शुचिस्मिते [[

गुणवत्ता,
 
-त्वम् 
__1 The possession of good qualities; गुणवत्तापि परप्रयोजना [[

p. p. [गुण् कर्मणि क्त] 
__1 Multiplied. 
__2 Heaped together, collected; कपोतौ स्नेहगुणितहृदयौ गृहधर्मिणौ [[

a. [गुण-इन्] 
__1 Possessed of or endowed with merits, meritorious; गुणी गुणं वेत्ति न वेत्ति निर्गुणः; [[

.]] 
__3 Familiar with the merits of anything. 
__4 Possessing qualities (as an object); गुणानां गुणिनां चैव परिणाममभीप्सताम् [[

.]] 
__6 Having (subordinate) parts, principal (Opp. गुण); गुणगुणिनोरेव सम्बन्धः. 
-नी A bow.

a. 
__1 Deprived of the original meaning or importance. 
__2 Made secondary or subordinate; गुणीभूताः स्म ते राजन् [[

.]] 
__3 Invested with attributes. 
__4 Made or having become a merit or ornament. 
__5 Varied according to qualities. 
__6 Having a certain force or application (as a word &c.). 
-Comp. 
-व्यङ्गथम् (in Rhet.) the second of the three divisions of Kāvya (poetry), in which the charm of the suggested sense is not more striking than that of the expressed one. [[S. D.]] thus defines it:--अपरं तु गुणीभूतव्यङ्ग्यं वाच्यादनुत्तमे व्यङ्गये । 265. This division of Kāvya is further subdivided into 8 classes; see [[S.

a. [गुण्-यत्] 
__1 Endowed with merits or virtues; गुण्यगुण्य इति न व्यजीगणत् [[Śi. 14. 47.]] 
__2 To be enumerated. 
__3 To be described or praised. 
__4 To be multiplied, the multiplicand.

€10U. (गुण्ठयति-ते, गुण्ठित) 
__1 To encircle, surround, envelop, enclose. 
__2 To hide, conceal.

__1 Concealing, covering, hiding. 
__2 Smearing, as in भस्मगुण्ठनम्.

€10P. (गुण्डयति, गुण्डित) 
__1 To cover, hide. 
__2 To pound, reduce to powder.

[गुण्ड्-अच्] 
__1 A kind of fragrant grass. 
__2 Pounding, grinding.

__1 Dust, power. 
__2 An oil-vessel. 
__3 A soft or low pleasing tone. 
__4 Dirty flour or meal.

f. 
__1 One of the twelve festivals of God Puruṣottama. 
__2 N. of this place of festival; [[Utkalakhaṇḍa.]]

a. 
__1 Pounded, ground. 
__2 Covered with dust.
